g.text: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY · Simulated data · No measured platform performance

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #81778c

g.text: Separate convergence from correction—and compare against a no-feedback condition.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #675d74

g.text: Left: 100 hypothetical paired panels per condition; bold lines show arithmetic means.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #675d74

g.text: Right: peer-feedback panels can converge while becoming either more or less accurate.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #81778c

g.text: DESIGN SIMULATION — NOT RESULTS. Disagreement and factual-accuracy scores are constructed here, not calculated from recorded ballots.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #81778c

g.text: Actual accuracy requires decidable claims; preferences have no truth score. Contours describe simulated density.
